players.product: AI data-center colocation (Tydal, Norway: 121 IT MW leased to Volta for NVIDIA GPUs) and Bitdeer AI GPU cloud (NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 / Vera Rubin capacity in Malaysia, Norway and the US)

quarterly_data.signal: May 2026 operations update: AI Cloud GPUs deployed 4,248 (April: 4,184), utilization 90% (April: 92%), GPUs under external subscription 3,305, ARR approximately $69M (April: ~$69M); completed the deployment and production launch of 2 units of NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 clusters. CFO Michael Potter: 'Tydal, Norway is in advanced stages of negotiations, representing the most visible proof point of our strategy to convert owned power into long-duration contracted revenue across our 3.0 GW global portfolio.'
quarterly_data.figure: ARR ~$69M; 90% utilization; 4,248 GPUs; 2 GB300 NVL72 clusters launched

quarterly_data.signal: Infrastructure (May 2026 update): due to delivery delays for key electrical components, 21 MW of pipeline capacity at Massillon, Ohio (planned usage: crypto) is expected to be energized in phases during Q3 2026. Online electrical capacity 1,797 MW, pipeline 1,206.5 MW, total global electrical capacity 3,003.5 MW.
quarterly_data.figure: 21 MW energization in Q3 2026 (electrical component delivery delays); 1,797 MW online; 3,003.5 MW total
